coordinate_convention: Legacy project VOC: center=((min+max)/2-1)/size, extent=(max-min)/size; invalid boxes are excluded for review, never silently clipped.
split_policy: Entire recording 20240527_3 is validation; entire recording 20240527_2 is test. All other canonical batches are training. Exact duplicate content is retained once, preferring held-out splits. Background variants must follow the original split and only augment training.
heldout_limit: Recording boundaries inferred from existing directory names; site separation is not established.
